query: SELECT json_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('mitro-bahini-memorials-source-boundary-224','intellectual-killing-source-boundary-225','pakistani-surrender-source-boundary-226','bangladesh-recognition-dispute-source-boundary-227','mujibnagar-administration-source-boundary-228')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0224-0228:%'),'search_documents',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 224 AND 228)) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
